newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN CMB FALLS 3 PCT ON SOFT DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN CMB FALLS 3 PCT ON SOFT DOLLAR.

text.p: Shares in Belgian shipping company CMB NV fell over three percent on Wednesday as investors continued to dump the share amid worries over the soft dollar.
"There's no particular reason for the drop, but it's one of the most dollar sensitive companies in Belgium," a trader said.
He added that there was "no real buying interest in the share at the moment, but with the absense of any real volume the drop isn't very significant".
By 1320 GMT the share was down 3.4 percent at 2,550 francs, with 13 million francs of shares traded. The price has dropped over nine percent since March 11.
